en.headline: CHP records two mpox cases; both men had high-risk contact
en.dek: A 32-year-old and a 28-year-old are stable in isolation. Officials said there is no known link between the cases or to earlier local infections.
body: The Centre for Health Protection said on Wednesday it is investigating two confirmed mpox cases involving men aged 32 and 28. Both are in isolation in hospital and in stable condition.

The older patient developed a mild fever from 29 August and later a rash on the face, trunk, limbs and genitals. He sought care at a private clinic and Queen Elizabeth Hospital on 7 September. He told investigators he had high-risk contact in Hong Kong with a man he did not know during the incubation period. The younger patient developed papules on the genitals from 4 September. The centre said both men will be reported to the World Health Organization.

Officials said there is so far no epidemiological link between the two cases or with earlier Hong Kong infections. Since 2022 the city has recorded 102 mpox cases, all in men. The centre again advised high-risk groups to get vaccinated and to avoid close physical contact with anyone who may be infected.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心公布兩宗猴痘確診 情況穩定
zh.dek: 32歲及28歲男子已入院隔離，暫時未發現兩案之間或與早前本地個案有流行病學關連。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心周三表示，正調查兩宗猴痘確診個案，分別涉及32歲及28歲男子。兩人已安排入院隔離治療，目前情況穩定。
較年長患者自8月29日起輕微發燒，其後面部、軀幹、四肢及生殖器官出疹，9月7日先後到私家診所及伊利沙伯醫院急症室求診。他表示潛伏期內曾在香港與一名陌生男子有高風險接觸。另一名28歲男子自本月4日起生殖器官出現丘疹。中心會將個案通報世界衞生組織。
中心指，暫時沒有資料顯示兩宗個案之間或與本港早前錄得的其他猴痘確診個案有流行病學關連，正繼續調查並設法聯繫高風險接觸者。自2022年至今本港共錄得102宗猴痘個案，全部病人均為男性。中心再次呼籲高風險群組接種疫苗，並避免與懷疑感染者作密切身體接觸。
